scripts.setup: npm run prisma:generate -w @qleaves/api && npm run prisma:migrate -w @qleaves/api && npm run prisma:seed -w @qleaves/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces && npm run typecheck:vercel
scripts.typecheck:vercel: tsc --noEmit --target ES2024 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node api/index.ts
scripts.vercel-build: npm run verify:vercel-config && node scripts/verify-vercel-env.mjs && npm run prisma:generate -w @qleaves/api && npm run typecheck && npm run build
